ei.title: Practice 01 — 도서관 도서 검열에 대한 반대 입장 표명
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: Dear Mr. Dennison: Thanks for thinking of me as a sponsor of your boycott. Like you, I want our children to grow up in a moral society. But I am afraid I can't give you permission to use my name as a support for Parents for Library Censorship. The fact is, you and I are on different sides of this issue ― namely, I am for freedom of speech and against censorship in any form. While I agree with you that some of the books on the list are of questionable quality and taste, I also feel just as strongly that no one person or organization has the right to determine what is 'suitable' literature for other people. I spoke out very strongly against library censorship at a recent parent-teachers meeting and I will do likewise when I have the opportunity. Sincerely, John Thomson

questions.passage: Dear Mr. Dennison: Thanks for ①<u>thinking</u> of me as a sponsor of your boycott. Like you, I want our children ②<u>to grow</u> up in a moral society. But I ③<u>being afraid</u> I can't ④<u>give</u> you permission to use my name as a support for Parents for Library Censorship. The fact is, you and I are on different sides of this issue ― namely, I am for freedom of speech and against censorship in any form. While I agree with you that some of the books on the list are of questionable quality and taste, I also feel just as strongly that no one person or organization has the right to determine what is 'suitable' literature for other people. I spoke out very strongly against library censorship at a recent parent-teachers meeting and I will do likewise when I have the opportunity. Sincerely, John Thomson
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① thinking=동명사 정상, ② to grow=to부정사 정상, ③ being afraid→am afraid 오류(주절 동사 필요), ④ give=조동사 뒤 원형 정상
det.analysis:
❌ ① thinking: 'Thanks for thinking of me' — 전치사 for 뒤 동명사 정상
❌ ② to grow: 'want our children to grow up' — want+목적어+to부정사 정상
✅ ③ being afraid: 'I am afraid I can't' — 주어+be동사+형용사 구조. am 자리에 being을 쓰면 주절에 동사가 없는 오류
❌ ④ give: 'can't give you permission' — 조동사 뒤 원형 정상
det.tip: 'I am afraid (that) S+V' — 주절 동사 am이 반드시 필요. being으로 쓰면 주절 동사 없는 구조 오류

questions.passage: Dear Mr. Dennison: Thanks for thinking of me as a sponsor of your boycott. Like you, I want our children to grow up in a moral society. But I am afraid I can't give you permission to use my name as a support for Parents for Library Censorship. The fact is, you and I are on different sides of this issue ― namely, ①<u>I am for freely</u> of speech and ②<u>against</u> censorship in any form. While I agree with you that some of the books on the list are of ③<u>questionable</u> quality and taste, I also feel just as strongly that no one person or organization has the right to ④<u>determine</u> what is 'suitable' literature for other people. I spoke out very strongly against library censorship at a recent parent-teachers meeting and I will do likewise when I have the opportunity. Sincerely, John Thomson
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① freely→freedom 오류(전치사 for 뒤 명사 필요), ② against=전치사 정상, ③ questionable=형용사 정상, ④ determine=to부정사 원형 정상
det.analysis:
✅ ① freely: 'I am for freedom of speech' — 전치사 for 뒤에는 명사(freedom). 부사 freely를 쓰면 품사 오류
❌ ② against: 'against censorship in any form' — 전치사 정상
❌ ③ questionable: 'of questionable quality and taste' — 형용사 정상
❌ ④ determine: 'has the right to determine' — to부정사 원형 정상
det.tip: 'be for+명사 / be against+명사' — for/against는 전치사. 뒤에 명사구 필요. 부사 freely 불가

questions.passage: Dear Mr. Dennison: Thanks for thinking of me as a sponsor of your boycott. Like you, I want our children to grow up in a moral society. But I am afraid I can't give you permission to use my name as a support for Parents for Library Censorship. The fact is, you and I are on different sides of this issue ― namely, I am for freedom of speech and against censorship in any form. While I agree with you ①<u>that</u> some of the books on the list are of questionable quality and taste, I also feel just as ②<u>strongly</u> that no one person or organization ③<u>has</u> the right to determine what is 'suitable' literature for other people. ④<u>I was spoken out</u> very strongly against library censorship at a recent parent-teachers meeting and I will do likewise when I have the opportunity. Sincerely, John Thomson
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① that=명사절 접속사 정상, ② strongly=부사 정상, ③ has=단수 주어 수일치 정상, ④ was spoken out→spoke out 오류(speak out 자동사구 수동태 불가)
det.analysis:
❌ ① that: 'I also feel that no one person...' — 동사 feel의 목적어절 접속사 정상
❌ ② strongly: 'feel just as strongly' — 부사 수식 정상
❌ ③ has: 'no one person or organization has the right' — 단수 주어 → 단수 동사 정상
✅ ④ was spoken out: 'I spoke out very strongly against library censorship' — speak out은 자동사구. 수동태 불가. spoke out(능동 과거)이 맞음
det.tip: speak out(공개 발언)은 자동사구 — 목적어 없으므로 수동태 불가. 능동 과거 spoke out만 가능

questions.passage: Dear Mr. Dennison: Thanks for thinking of me as a sponsor of your boycott. Like you, I want our children to grow up in a ①<u>moral</u> society. But I am afraid I can't give you permission to use my name as a support for Parents for Library Censorship. The fact is, you and I are on different sides of this issue ― namely, I am for freedom of speech and ②<u>for censorship</u> in any form. While I agree with you that some of the books on the list are of ③<u>questionable</u> quality and taste, I also feel just as strongly that no one person or organization has the right to determine what is '④<u>suitable</u>' literature for other people. I spoke out very strongly against library censorship at a recent parent-teachers meeting and I will do likewise when I have the opportunity. Sincerely, John Thomson
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① moral=도덕적인(적절), ② for censorship→against censorship 오류(필자는 검열 반대), ③ questionable=의심스러운(적절), ④ suitable=적합한(적절)
det.analysis:
❌ ① moral: 'grow up in a moral society' — 도덕적 사회에서 성장하길 원한다는 문맥 적절
✅ ② for censorship: 필자는 'against censorship in any form'이라고 밝혔으므로 for(찬성)로 바꾸면 문맥 반전
❌ ③ questionable: 'of questionable quality and taste' — 품질이 의심스럽다는 문맥 적절
❌ ④ suitable: 'what is suitable literature' — 적합한 문학이라는 표현 문맥 적절
det.tip: 필자 입장: 검열 반대(against). 'I am for freedom of speech and against censorship' 참조

questions.passage: Dear Mr. Dennison: Thanks for thinking of me as a sponsor of your boycott. Like you, I want our children to grow up in a moral society. But I am afraid I can't give you permission to use my name as a support for Parents for Library Censorship. The fact is, you and I are on ①<u>different</u> sides of this issue ― namely, I am for freedom of speech and against censorship in any form. While I ③<u>disagree</u> with you that some of the books on the list are of questionable quality and taste, I also feel just as ②<u>strongly</u> that no one person or organization has the right to determine what is 'suitable' literature for other people. I spoke out very strongly against library censorship at a recent parent-teachers meeting and I will do likewise when I have the ④<u>opportunity</u>. Sincerely, John Thomson
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① different=다른(적절), ② strongly=강하게(적절), ③ disagree→agree 오류(일부 책 질은 동의함), ④ opportunity=기회(적절)
det.analysis:
❌ ① different: 'on different sides of this issue' — 서로 다른 입장이라는 문맥 적절
❌ ② strongly: 'feel just as strongly' — 강하게 느낀다는 문맥 적절
✅ ③ disagree: 'While I disagree with you that some books are of questionable quality...' — 필자는 일부 책의 질이 의심스럽다는 점에는 동의(agree)함. disagree로 바꾸면 문맥 반전
❌ ④ opportunity: 'when I have the opportunity' — 기회가 있을 때라는 문맥 적절
det.tip: 'While I agree with you that some books are of questionable quality, I also feel...' — 부분 동의 후 반박 양보 구조. agree가 맞음

questions.passage: Dear Mr. Dennison: Thanks for thinking of me as a sponsor of your boycott. Like you, I want our children to grow up in a moral society. But I am afraid I can't give you permission to use my name as a support for Parents for Library Censorship. The fact is, you and I are on different sides of this issue ― namely, I am for __________ and against censorship in any form. While I agree with you that some of the books on the list are of questionable quality and taste, I also feel just as strongly that no one person or organization has the right to determine what is 'suitable' literature for other people. I spoke out very strongly against library censorship at a recent parent-teachers meeting and I will do likewise when I have the opportunity. Sincerely, John Thomson
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① freedom of speech=표현의 자유(정답), ② library censorship=도서관 검열(반대 개념), ③ moral education=언급 없음, ④ parental authority=무관
det.analysis:
① freedom of speech ←정답: 'I am for __________ and against censorship in any form' — 필자가 지지하는 가치
② library censorship: 필자가 반대하는 개념
③ moral education: 지문에 등장하지 않음
④ parental authority: 지문과 무관
det.tip: 'I am for A and against B' 구조. B=censorship이므로 A는 대조되는 freedom of speech

questions.passage: Dear Mr. Dennison: Thanks for thinking of me as a sponsor of your boycott. Like you, I want our children to grow up in a moral society. But I am afraid I can't give you permission to use my name as a support for Parents for Library Censorship. The fact is, you and I are on different sides of this issue ― namely, I am for freedom of speech and against censorship in any form. While I agree with you that some of the books on the list are of questionable quality and taste, I also feel just as strongly that no one person or organization has the right to determine what is '__________' literature for other people. I spoke out very strongly against library censorship at a recent parent-teachers meeting and I will do likewise when I have the opportunity. Sincerely, John Thomson
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① questionable=의심스러운, ② reliable=믿을 수 있는, ③ significant=중요한, ④ suitable=적합한(정답)
det.analysis:
① questionable: '의심스러운 문학'으로 바꾸면 논점 이탈
② reliable: '믿을 수 있는 문학'은 문맥상 어색
③ significant: '중요한 문학'은 문맥에서 필자가 반대하는 개념과 무관
④ suitable ←정답: 'no one person or organization has the right to determine what is __________ literature for other people' — 누가 적합한 문학인지 결정할 권리가 없다는 문맥. suitable이 가장 적절
det.tip: 'what is suitable literature for other people' — 타인을 위해 어떤 문학이 적합한지. suitable = 적합한

questions.passage: Dear Mr. Dennison: Thanks for thinking of me as a sponsor of your boycott. Like you, I want our children to grow up in a moral society. questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ① 일치, ② 불일치(허락하지 않았음), ③ 일치, ④ 일치
det.analysis:
① 일치: 'Thanks for thinking of me as a sponsor of your boycott'
② 불일치 ←정답: 'I can't give you permission to use my name as a support for Parents for Library Censorship' — 허락하지 않음
③ 일치: 'you and I are on different sides of this issue'
④ 일치: 'I spoke out very strongly against library censorship at a recent parent-teachers meeting'
det.tip: can't give permission = 허락 거부. ②의 '허락했다'가 불일치

ch: 필자는 Dennison 씨의 불매운동 후원자로 생각해준 것에 감사를 표했다.
필자는 도서관 검열 찬성 단체를 지지하는 데 자신의 이름 사용을 허락했다.
필자와 Dennison 씨는 이 문제에서 서로 다른 입장에 있다.
필자는 최근 학부모-교사 회의에서 도서관 검열에 반대 의견을 표명했다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ① 불일치(일부는 질 의심), ② 불일치(검열 찬성 단체), ③ 일치, ④ 불일치(기회 될 때 발언)
det.analysis:
① 불일치: 'some of the books on the list are of questionable quality and taste' — 일부는 질이 의심스럽다고 인정
② 불일치: Dennison은 'Parents for Library Censorship'(검열 찬성)에 필자를 후원자로 요청
③ 일치 ←정답: 'I am against censorship in any form'
④ 불일치: 'I will do likewise when I have the opportunity' — 앞으로도 발언할 것
det.tip: 'against censorship in any form' — 어떤 형태의 검열도 반대. ③이 정확히 일치

ch: 필자는 도서관 목록에 있는 모든 책의 질이 훌륭하다고 생각한다.
Dennison 씨는 표현의 자유를 지지하는 단체를 운영하고 있다.
필자는 앞으로 도서관 검열에 대한 의견을 공개적으로 말하지 않겠다고 했다.

det.korean: ① 일치, ② 일치, ③ 불일치(다른 입장이라고 했음), ④ 일치
det.analysis:
① 일치: 'Dear Mr. Dennison' / 'Sincerely, John Thomson'

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 검열 지지 후원 거부 및 표현의 자유 지지(정답), ② 부적절한 책 제거 절차, ③ 학부모-교사 협력, ④ 독서 도덕 기준
det.analysis:
① 정답 ←: 편지 핵심 = 도서관 검열 후원 거부(can't give permission) + 표현의 자유 지지(for freedom of speech)
② 불일치: 책 제거 절차는 언급되지 않음
③ 불일치: 협력 방안이 아니라 개인 입장 표명
④ 불일치: 도덕적 기준 마련 지지 내용 없음
det.tip: 편지 목적: Dennison의 요청 거절 + 필자 입장(표현의 자유 지지, 검열 반대) 표명

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 도서 질적 기준, ② 독서 선택권 결정 불가(정답), ③ 검열의 긍정적 기여, ④ 부모 통제 필요

② 정답 ←: 'no one person or organization has the right to determine what is suitable literature for other people' — 타인의 독서 적합성을 결정할 권리는 누구에게도 없다
